title: Inspect repository metadata and documentation index
outcome: Return repository identity, description and default branch from the approved metadata source and the exact documentation index from the approved documentation source. The exact text is bounded to 8192 UTF-8 bytes; larger source values fail rather than being silently truncated.
non_guarantees: Does not cover unapproved collections or assert that source-provided content is universally correct.

preconditions.description: Inputs select an approved read-only collection.
Read authority for the approved source is required.
Read authority for the documentation source is required.

postconditions.criterion: Return repository identity, description and default branch from the approved metadata source and the exact documentation index from the approved documentation source. The exact text is bounded to 8192 UTF-8 bytes; larger source values fail rather than being silently truncated.
evidence_required: Receiver-generated successful source-operation receipts and digest-verified source artifacts.

failures.meaning: A required approved source is unavailable, denied, or outside the allocation.
